The platform for clonal crops at global scale

NXT’s platform was built for clonal propagation at global scale — applied selectively across crops where eliminating labour unlocks the strongest commercial outcome.

NXT’s platform was built from first principles for clonal propagation at global scale.

Today, the platform is in active production or development across the crops where automated tissue culture offers the strongest commercial outcome — from staple food crops to specialist horticulture, from broadacre agriculture and bioenergy to ornamental nurseries.
